subject: Private deployment coordination / MSA + Order Form redlines (HelioHealth)
messages:
From: Laura Smith <l.smith@heliohealth.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment - MSA/order form redlines & audit evidence request

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough earlier this week. HelioHealth is prioritizing a VPC/private deployment for our new ML inference platform (PHI+ workload). Before we scope a PO, legal/procurement have a set of redlines and a list of evidence items we need:

- Clarify license scope for on-prem/VPC: is the license per-node, per-seat, or per-instance? Are there limits on cores/GPU types?
- Operator access boundary: who at Redwood will have operator access for upgrade/incident support? We need a clear escalation matrix.
- Snapshot/escrow-like option: in the event of vendor insolvency or prolonged breach, we need a mechanism to obtain a runnable snapshot and the necessary artifacts to resume operations. Not asking for full source escrow, but a defined export path and attestation.
- Audit evidence: SOC 2 report, data retention controls, and runbook extract for on-prem deployments. Also a short checklist of what you can provide for an external audit (logs, access history, image provenance).

Can you confirm Redwood's stance on the above and propose timing for redline exchange? If possible, we'd like a 45-minute redline review with legal + infra on your side next week.

For context I'm looping in procurement (procurement@heliohealth.com) and our internal counsel (legal@heliohealth.com). I've attached our RFP excerpt for private hosting.

Thanks,
Laura
Procurement Manager, HelioHealth
laura.smith@heliohealth.com

Attachment: Helio_RFP_Dec2027.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Laura Smith <l.smith@heliohealth.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - MSA/order form redlines & audit evidence request

Hi Laura — thank you, and appreciate the RFP excerpt.

Quick summary / proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) License scope: for private/VPC we typically license per-deployment (logical tenant) with tiering by throughput rather than strict per-GPU counts. We can add a fallback metric (e.g., vGPU-equivalent) in the Order Form if Helio needs hard caps — Markus, see note for legal redline.
2) Operator access boundary: Redwood can commit to role-limited operator access via a documented runbook; for sensitive PHI workloads we support two options: (A) Remote support with just-in-time ephemeral access + recorded session exports, or (B) no direct operator access and bundled operator runbooks + remote health probes with a customer-managed incident hop. I'll outline contacts and SLA carveouts in an annex.
3) Snapshot/escrow-lite: we offer an "Escrow Lite" option: periodic encrypted snapshots (container images + DB export instructions) delivered to a custodian (or to Helio) under a predefined trigger (insolvency or sustained SLA failure). This isn't source code escrow but is intended to provide operational continuity. Markus — I'll need a short redline to the MSA to capture trigger language and custody flow.
4) Audit evidence: we can provide SOC2 Type II, runbook extract, and a package describing log retention and export capabilities. Karthik will enumerate the exact artifacts and an estimated delivery window.

Proposed cadence:
- I will share an annotated MSA + Order Form with high-level annotations by EOD Monday.
- Markus and Karthik to prepare suggested redline language (operator boundary + escrow-lite) by Tuesday.
- 45-min redline meeting Wednesday 10:00-10:45 PT (if that works for your legal team).

Action items assigned: Camila -> annotated docs, Markus -> legal language, Karthik -> evidence inventory and timelines. Laura/Billing team -> confirm preferred meeting cadence and whether a custodian is acceptable for snapshots.

Attaching a short action plan doc with proposed schedule.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
Attachment: Camila_Helio_Rolling_Action_Plan.pdf (PDF, 28KB)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Laura Smith <l.smith@heliohealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment - MSA/order form redlines & audit evidence request

Laura / Camila — I'm Markus on Redwood Legal. Quick notes after reviewing the ask and Camila's proposal:

1) License metric: we can accept a throughput-tiered Order Form with a hard cap addendum. Proposed clause: "License granting customer non-exclusive rights to deploy the runtime for Customer-owned infrastructure subject to the capacity limits specified in the Order Form; capacity to be defined in vGPU-equivalent units and replaceable by a mutually-agreed metric."

2) Operator access: will propose two alternative clauses for options A and B. For Option A (ephemeral remote access) we will include: specific roles, approval flow, audit log retention (90 days), and an emergency escalation path (contact list + timestamp SLA). For Option B (no operator access) we will include extended runbook obligations and a remediation SLA for patching.

3) Escrow-lite: draft suggestion attached. Key points: trigger events (insolvency, material sustained breach >60 days), deliverables (exportable images, container runbook, license keys/crypto handling instructions), and custodian acceptance. We will not provide source code or proprietary tooling. Customer requested custody of snapshots is acceptable if it aligns with our encryption/key handback model — we will need a limited transfer-of-key attestation to avoid unencrypted secrets landing with third parties.

4) Evidence package: list of artifacts Redwood can provide will be added to an exhibit; expect a delivery timeline of 10 business days after signed NDA / Order Form.

I'll attach comments to the MSA and produce a short redline memo. Camila, please send the MSA + Order Form copy to markus_klein@redwood.com and I'll run markup.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Markus_comments.docx (DOCX, 18KB)

Thanks Camila — Wed 10:00 PT works for our counsel. A couple clarifications from our side (we're trying to be explicit so internal counsel can sign off quickly):

- By "custodian" for snapshots we mean a neutral third-party escrow agent or Helio's security team (we prefer neutral escrow for custody). Please confirm whether Redwood is willing to ship encrypted snapshots to a named escrow agent and what controls are in place for key transfer.
- For the trigger language, Helio needs a shorter remediation window: 30 days for material breach remediation before a remedial escrow trigger (not 60). Would Redwood accept 30 days?
- We also need a technical attestation that a deployment export will include provenance metadata (image hashes, SBOM pointer) sufficient to validate integrity and for FOSS compliance.

On scheduling: our counsel would like the redline meeting to include a short demo (10-15 min) of the export process (can be screenshare) — can Karthik or someone from infra run that?

Laura
Procurement Manager, HelioHealth
